LESSON: APPROXIMATIONS AND ERRORS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Measurements 3.5 Money (7 lessons) • Currencies of other countries • Currency co
Topic 3.6: Approximations and Errors
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Approximations and Errors, part of Measurements 3.5 Money (7 lessons) • Currencies of other countries • Currency co in Grade 9 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do we estimate measurements of different quantities?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Approximations and Errors together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and Imagination: learner carries out measurements of different quantities and discusses the error.

● Digital Literacy: learner uses IT devices to compute errors.

Values:
● Integrity: learner measures different quantities and minimizes errors.

● Responsibility: learner takes care of tools for measuring different quantities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Safety: learner handles measuring tools with care.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Integrated Science: learner measures different quantities that may involve errors as they carry out experiments.
